script:
Hey guys, let's talk AI. Did you know that the first AI program was created in 1951 by Alan Turing? It was called the Logical Theorist.

Fast forward to today and we've got AI assistants like Siri and Alexa that can answer your questions and control your smart home devices. But did you know that these AI systems are actually just really complex algorithms?

And get this, some AIs can even learn from their mistakes! That's right, they're getting better at doing things wrong. It's like they say, "the more you fail, the closer you get to success".

But here's the thing, most AIs aren't conscious or self-aware. They're just really good at simulating human-like behavior. So next time you talk to Siri, don't assume she's thinking what you're thinking.

And finally, did you know that there are AIs that can create art and music? Like, actually generate new stuff that humans could never come up with on their own. It's like they're trying to steal our creative genius!
